title: Checkout 500s after the 09:22 release
root_cause_summary: Release v2026.3.17-a1 dereferenced an optional discount field that is absent for guest carts, so every guest checkout raised a TypeError.

required_evidence.why: the deploy that introduced the regression, one minute before onset
the exception naming the field and handler
the error_rate series at onset, showing the step change in error rate

red_herrings.why_tempting: an earlier deploy on the same service, but 19 minutes before onset
